command: cat src/commands/*.json | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 5
echo a b c | xargs -n 1 echo
grep -q for src/commands/xinfo-stream.json && echo found || echo none
i=0; while [ $i -lt 10000 ]; do i=$((i+1)); done; echo $i
i=10; until [ $i -eq 0 ]; do i=$((i-1)); done; echo $i
for f in src/commands/*.json; do echo "$f"; done | wc -l
for f in src/commands/*.json; do grep -c for "$f"; done | sort -n | tail -n 3
n=0; for f in src/commands/*.json; do if grep -q between "$f"; then n=$((n+1)); fi; done; echo $n
for f in src/commands/*.json; do if [ -s "$f" ]; then continue; fi; echo "$f"; done
H=$PWD; for d in tests .github src/commands; do cd "$d"; ls | wc -l; cd "$H"; done
find .github -name '*.json' | while read -r f; do wc -l < "$f"; done | sort -n | tail -n 1
for f in src/commands/*.json; do head -n 1 "$f"; done > /dev/null
for i in 1 2 3; do for j in a b; do if [ $i -eq 2 ]; then break; fi; echo $i$j; done; done
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk '{ print $2 }' | wc -l
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk '/for/ { n++ } END { print n }'
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk '{ s += NF } END { print s, NR }'
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk -F: '{ s += $3 } END { print s }'
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk 'FNR == 1 { print FILENAME }' | wc -l
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk 'length($0) > 100 { n++ } END { print n + 0 }'
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk '{ c[$1]++ } END { for (k in c) n++; print n }'
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk '{ for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i == "for") n++ } END { print n }'
awk -v OFS=- '{ $1 = NR; print }' src/commands/xinfo-stream.json | tail -n 1
awk 'BEGIN { for (i = 0; i < 100000; i++) s += i * i; printf "%d\n", s }'
grep -rn implementing . | awk -F: '{ print $1 }' | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 5
cat src/commands/*.json | tr -cd '[:print:][:space:]' | awk 'NF > 3 { print $1, $NF }' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -n 5
